    • readMaterial

      protected boolean readMaterial(String _strKeyName, Map<String,Object> _mapItems, List<AMaterialManager.MaterialInformation> _lstMaterialsInformation, boolean _bIsEmptyAllowed, Function<AMaterialManager.MaterialInformation,Boolean> _lambdaIsMaterialInformationValid)
      Read material with extra informations.
      Parameters:
      _strKeyName - Key name to retrieve the list of materials informations (name / regex and extra informations).
      _mapItems - Map where to find informations.
      _lstMaterialsInformation - Materials information list to fill.
      _bIsEmptyAllowed - If empty is not allowed, return false if the key doesn't exists, else just not fill _lstMaterialsInformation.
      _lambdaIsMaterialInformationValid - Lambda to check if the material information is valid for this search. If null all is allowed.
      Returns:
      true if no error, false else.

    • findRegions

      protected Set<String> findRegions(ArrayList<String> _listRegionsNames, Consumer<String> _lambdaInfoAdd, Consumer<String> _lambdaInfoInvalid)
      Get a list of regions names from a _listRegionsNames.

      _lambdaInfoAdd - Lambda to display log that this region is added.
